obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical relation; finite correspondence evidence only
obernants.assumptions: Successful standard allocations, terminating single-threaded calls
obernants.domain: Declared bounded API inputs, states and finite fixtures
obernants.observation_scope: Exact values, index order, state transitions and named assertions
obernants.operator: For any admitted point sequence P and query q, candidate None is excluded exactly when P is nonempty; candidate (i,d) is excluded if i is absent, d differs from squared distance, or another (distance,j) is lexicographically smaller. Invalid constructor inputs paired with Ok are excluded. The deterministic median shape further constrains internal state.

obernants.operator: An observed (i,d) admits all bounded point sequences containing point i at squared distance d from q with no lexicographically better competitor. Coordinate sign changes and extra farther points yield ambiguous preimages. None reconstructs an empty stored sequence but does not identify query q.

obernants.operator: Stored coordinate absolute value <=10^6 and arbitrary i32 query imply each absolute difference <=2^31+10^6; twice its square <2^64. i64 subtraction and u64 sum are exact; i128 test oracle independently computes the same mathematical metric.
